title: Design System: The Hobbit Pick Order

favicon.description: A browser-size interpretation of the HOB expansion ring-and-blade mark in gold, oxblood, and Forest Deep.

display.purpose: The complete-atlas title, Trail training title, and singular page-level statements.

rank.purpose: Pick numbers and training-context positions with tabular numerals.

body.purpose: Instructions, source context, and explanatory copy.

title.purpose: Card names and high-scan working content.

search.purpose: Primary text entry beside compact card imagery.

label.purpose: Dataset and score stamps, controls, counts, filters, and tier metadata.

shadows.name: cloth-binding
shadows.purpose: Lifts the masthead from the atlas ground.

shadows.name: page-flag
shadows.purpose: Gives navigation flags a light handled-paper lift.

shadows.name: open-volume
shadows.purpose: Lifts each active atlas leaf as the principal object.

shadows.name: search-focus
shadows.purpose: Deepens while the search field owns input.

shadows.name: card-thumbnail
shadows.purpose: Separates card art from dense map rows.

shadows.name: training-card-image
shadows.purpose: Gives the one studied card clear physical focus on its forest stage.

shadows.name: card-preview
shadows.purpose: Lifts the shared inspection plate above its trigger or pinned forest scrim.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing for flags, controls, and visibility changes.

motion.name: training-answer-reveal
motion.purpose: One-shot answer and rank-context reveal after a guess.

components.name: Clothbound Header
components.description: Forest-cloth masthead with compass mark, book title, dataset provenance, and mountain-edge rule.
components.html:
The Hobbit Pick OrderAn expedition atlas for the next pick
188cards
19 Aug 2026
components.css: .ds-cloth-header { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; min-height: 142px; padding: 18px clamp(20px, 4vw, 58px) 22px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(22, 39, 31, .2); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-cloth-brand { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 17px; } .ds-cloth-compass { width: 54px; height: 54px; color: var(--brass-light); } .ds-cloth-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-cloth-copy strong { font: 700 clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.7rem)/.98 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-cloth-copy small { color: #d2dacd; font-size: .82rem; } .ds-cloth-stamp { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; align-items: center; min-width: 154px; padding: 10px 16px; color: var(--forest-deep); background: var(--brass-light); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(22, 39, 31, .24); font-size: .72rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-cloth-stamp > strong { margin-right: 10px; font: 700 2.25rem/.85 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-cloth-mountains { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 54px; color: var(--forest-deep); }

components.name: Page Flag Topology
components.description: The complete three-page atlas topology, with one raised brass flag and compact mobile labels.

components.name: Trail Training Header
components.description: Literary training heading paired with the lifted brass session score stamp and colour-filter trail.
components.html:
Trail training

} .ds-training-toolbar h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 1.5rem/1 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-training-toolbar p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; } .ds-training-filters { display: flex; components.name: Atlas Search Field
components.description: Warm map-leaf search control with forest stroke and integrated clear action.
components.css: .ds-atlas-search { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr 40px; align-items: center; min-height: 68px; padding: 0 11px 0 18px; color: var(--forest-deep); background: var(--paper-light); border: 2px solid var(--forest); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(64, 54, 37, .13); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-atlas-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--oxblood); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(64, 54, 37, .19); } .ds-atlas-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); } .ds-atlas-search-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-atlas-search-input { min-width: 0; height: 64px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--forest-deep); caret-color: var(--oxblood); background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; font: 700 clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.25rem)/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-atlas-search-clear { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-atlas-search-clear:hover { background: var(--oxblood); } .ds-atlas-search-clear:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-atlas-search-clear:active { transform: scale(.96); } .ds-atlas-search-clear svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; }

components.name: Search Result Row
components.description: Passive lookup row using the lightweight 80 × 112 local thumbnail source, with an Alegreya rank lane, colour identity, one tier badge, and a shared preview trigger on the art alone.
components.css: .ds-search-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 54px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 82px; padding: 9px 8px 9px 2px; color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-search-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 55px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgba(49, 43, 32, .2); font-size: .56rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-search-rank { align-self: stretch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding-right: 8px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-search-rank strong { font: 700 1.7rem/1 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-search-rank small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-search-name { display: grid; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-search-name strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.22; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search-name small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; } .ds-search-tier { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 34px; min-height: 24px; color: #fff; background: #a55d40; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Shared Card Preview
components.description: One on-demand 672 × 936 inspection plate shared by Search and All cards: hover or focus is transient; click or tap pins it over a forest scrim, traps focus on the 42px caption close control, closes by control, backdrop, or Escape, and keeps the local 80 × 112 thumbnail as fallback.
components.css: .ds-card-preview-layer { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 650px; padding: 14px; overflow: hidden; pointer-events: none; color: var(--paper-light); background: transparent; font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-card-preview-backdrop, .ds-card-preview-close { display: none; } .ds-card-preview-panel { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: min(320px, calc(100% - 24px)); margin: 0; padding: 10px; color: var(--paper-light); background-color: var(--forest-deep); background-image: linear-gradient(112deg, rgba(255,255,255,.035), transparent 36%, rgba(0,0,0,.07)), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255,255,255,.018) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 22px 60px rgba(7, 20, 13, .42); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px) scale(.985); transition: opacity 160ms var(--ease-out), transform 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-card-preview-layer[data-open="true"] .ds-card-preview-panel { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } .ds-card-preview-image { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 672 / 936; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 6px; transition: filter 160ms var(--ease-out), opacity 160ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-card-preview-image span { max-width: 14ch; font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-preview-image.ds-is-loading { filter: blur(1px); opacity: .82; } .ds-card-preview-caption { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 4px 2px; } .ds-card-preview-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-preview-copy strong { overflow: hidden; font: 700 1rem/1.05 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-preview-copy > span { color: var(--brass-light); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-preview-layer.ds-is-pinned { pointer-events: auto; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--forest-deep) 82%, transparent); } .ds-card-preview-layer.ds-is-pinned .ds-card-preview-backdrop { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: zoom-out; } .ds-card-preview-layer.ds-is-pinned .ds-card-preview-panel { width: min(360px, calc(100% - 28px)); } .ds-card-preview-layer.ds-is-pinned .ds-card-preview-close { display: grid; flex: 0 0 42px; place-items: center; width: 42px; height: 42px; padding: 0; color: var(--paper-light); background: var(--forest-deep); border: 1px solid var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(22, 39, 31, .16); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-preview-close:hover { background: var(--oxblood); } .ds-card-preview-close:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card-preview-close svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card-preview-panel, .ds-card-preview-image { transition: none; } }

components.name: Exact Tier Choice Map

components.description: Passive colour-grouped atlas entry using the lightweight 80 × 112 local thumbnail source, with rank, title, tier, and the same art-only preview trigger.

components.css: .ds-atlas-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 112px; padding: 11px 5px; color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-atlas-thumb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; aspect-ratio: 125.3 / 176.4; color: var(--muted); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 5px 13px rgba(49, 43, 32, .2); font-size: .56rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-atlas-copy { display: block; min-width: 0; } .ds-atlas-rank { display: block; color: #254a5b; font: 700 1.25rem/1 "Alegreya", Georgia, serif; } .ds-atlas-copy > strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: .92rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-atlas-tier { display: grid; place-items: center; width: fit-content; min-width: 34px; min-height: 24px; margin-top: 8px; color: #fff; background: #2f644d; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
The system turns a pick order into a working expedition volume. Forest-cloth binding and brass page flags frame warm map leaves; contour lines, oxblood route marks, river-blue details, and compass geometry create a sense of place without becoming decorative fantasy. It should feel learned, practical, companionable, and ready to be opened mid-journey for a quick decision.

Hierarchy remains operational inside that world. Alegreya gives titles and ranks a bookish editorial voice, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next keeps search and metadata exceptionally legible, and each page turn has one clear job: Search looks up a card’s rank and tier, Cards browses the complete set, and Train rehearses exact tiers. The training leaf belongs to the same atlas rather than becoming a dashboard or separate product. The system rejects generic dashboard chrome and theatrical parchment styling; materials stay quiet enough for immediate interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Forest-cloth framing around warm, lightly contoured map leaves.
Alegreya for titles and ranks; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for working text.
Brass page flags for navigation, provenance, and route wayfinding.
Oxblood route marks for search focus and training outcomes; river blue for cartographic detail.
Three page turns—Search, Cards, and Train—within one continuous atlas topology.
A single-card forest training stage paired with an exact-tier map and immediate rank context.
Restrained tactile shadows that make the atlas feel handled rather than glossy.

rules.name: The Route Mark Rule
rules.body: Oxblood belongs to search focus, training feedback, route emphasis, and consequential actions; it is never a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Brass Flag Rule
rules.body: Brass identifies places to turn, clear, or orient. Keep it compact so it continues to read as a page flag or waypoint.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Leaves Rule
rules.body: Primary reading happens in Contour Ink on Map Leaf. Forest reversals are reserved for binding, navigation, controls, and the training stage.

rules.name: The Tier-Truth Rule
rules.body: Every training choice uses its established tier colour as a quiet tinted fill and border; only the correct choice becomes fully saturated, while the selected wrong choice moves to Oxblood.

rules.name: The Literary Utility Rule
rules.body: Use Alegreya for page hierarchy and ranks; use Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for every instruction, control, and dense list detail.

rules.name: The No-Costume Rule
rules.body: Preserve Alegreya’s natural case and editorial rhythm. Do not simulate medieval lettering with all-caps display type, blackletter, or decorative tracking.

rules.name: The Single-Leaf Rule
rules.body: Search, Cards, and Train each own one map leaf and one task; never merge them into competing dashboard panels.

rules.name: The Bound-Object Rule
rules.body: Elevate the atlas as one handled object; do not distribute independent card-panel shadows across the leaves.

rules.name: The Bound-Corner Rule
rules.body: Preserve the square flag-to-leaf join; rounding all four corners would break the open-book silhouette.

rules.name: The Map-Mark Rule
rules.body: Decorative geometry must read as navigation—compass, contour, route, mountain, or colour emblem—not as generic fantasy ornament.

rules.name: The Single Tier Mark Rule
rules.body: One tinted fill and one border communicate each tier choice. Do not duplicate the tier colour with an extra stripe.

dos: Do frame warm map leaves with Forest Cloth and preserve the square page-flag join.
Do reserve Oxblood for route marks, search focus, training feedback, and consequential actions.
Do use brass for page flags, provenance, route ticks, and waypoint controls.
Do keep Alegreya on titles and ranks while Atkinson Hyperlegible Next handles working text.
Do preserve card rank, tier, Magic-colour grouping, keyboard focus, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep contour and route imagery quiet enough that card names and ranks remain dominant.
Do keep all 15 tier choices visible and distinguish correct, near-miss, wrong, and reveal outcomes without changing their labels.
Do show global rank with One above, This card, and One below context after every answer when those neighbours exist.
Do keep training filters, score, queue, and requeue behavior session-only and honest about resetting on refresh.
Do load only the inspected high-resolution image and preserve the precached thumbnail as its offline fallback.
donts: Don't substitute loud synthetic signal colours or monochrome machinery panels for the atlas palette.
Don't turn the atlas into theatrical parchment with distressed edges, blackletter, gold filigree, or lore ornament.
Don't use Oxblood or Brass as broad decorative backgrounds across the map leaves.
Don't wrap each ranked row in its own rounded, elevated card.
Don't add a redundant five-pixel bottom stripe or pseudo-element to tier choices; the tinted fill and border are sufficient.
Don't add pack selection or turn passive search and atlas entries into action controls.
Don't let preview controls obscure mana cost, rules text, or other parts of the card face.
Don't mix search, complete atlas, and training into competing dashboard panels.
Don't imply training progress persists or add localStorage, an account, or backend state to support it.
Don't replace literal card, rank, state, and colour labels with ambiguous icons alone.
